title: Sean Samoan Triptych
description: Three identical illustrations of a muscular bald man with tribal tattoos, wearing a grey compression shirt and shorts, posed in a fighting stance with mouth open. The character panels are placed over large black stenciled text reading SEAN SAMOAN on a bright pink background, all encased in clear plastic.
prompt: Three identical panels of a fierce bald Samoan fighter with tribal tattoos on his head and arms, wearing a tight grey compression shirt and shorts, standing in an aggressive MMA fighting stance with fists raised and mouth open shouting. The three character studies are arranged horizontally inside a white border, placed over large bold black stenciled text that reads SEAN SAMOAN against a vibrant hot pink background, the entire piece wrapped in clear crinkled plastic sheeting.
